The Addl. Central Provident Fund Commissioner (NER),
Regional P.F. Commissioner (Assam) Guwahati,

Subject:- Submission of Aadhaar as identity document by the Pensioners and Members of the
EPS, 1995 — regarding.

Sir,

Attention is drawn to this office circular No. Pen-I/17(10)2016-17/Jeevan Pramaan/2609
dated 04.05.2017, circular No. Pen-I/17(10)/2016-17/Jeevan Pramaan/4792 dated 05.06.2017 and Pen-
1/17(10)2016-17/Jeevan Pramaan/13312 dated 20.09.2017 on the cited subject.

As difficulties are still being faced in submission of Aadhar as identify document by the
pensioners & Members of EPS 1995 in the state of Assam, the issue is again re-examined & it has been
decided that Aadhar may not be insisted from new members who join EPS 1995 till 31.03.2018 in Assam.

Similarly Aadhar may also not be insisted for composite pension claim form for members working
in establishment located in the state of Assam till 31.03.2018.

[This issues with the approval of CPFC]

Addl. Central PF Commissioner-IT (Pension)

Copy to:

i) PS to CPFC.

ii) FA&CAO.

iii) All ACCs (HQ).

iv) All ACCs-I/II in Headquarters.

v) ALL ACCs (Zone).

vi) Deputy Director (OL) for Hindi version.

vii) RPFC-I (NDC) for necessary action and a request for web upload.
